title: Someone knows how to translate from spanish?

posts.author: Vladar458
posts.body:
I'm asking this because i'm from Spain, and the game i'm currently making is in spanish. And while i know english well enough to do the job myself, that would be a bit tedious for me.
It would be that, translating a RPG Maker MV game from spanish to english. I have not completed my game yet, but is in a very advanced state.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Not sure what the question is. The workload is the same. If it's too tedious for you, I guess hire someone?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
There are lots of free tools, such as Google Translate.
However, I would strongly recommend you only consider that to be a starting point - if you want your game to be taken seriously, you should really look up and hire a native English proofreader/editor.
One of the biggest reasons I'll immediately delete and get a refund from a game is poor English.

posts.author: gstv87
posts.body:
AI is still not perfect for translations, but it's approaching the OK point where it'll give you a decent product, that you can then pitch to your translator for corrections... it's better than having to translate the whole thing.
the main problem is the lack of context and the inability to figure it out, especially with regional slang or things that have no equivalent in the other language.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: AI is good enough for casual use like message board posts but it will occasionally get things wrong and I wouldn't trust it with a professional product I intend to sell. If you do use it you should absolutely double check the output and don't just copy and paste it verbatim into your game.
